title: System Integration — PP Pipeline + Simulation + CAM + Fusion 360
description: Wire the feasibility stack into all PRISM subsystems: PP pipeline Stage 0.8 (pre-check), CNC simulation bridge (IPW-aware physics), CAM program assembly pre-hook, and Fusion 360 LiveBridge for real geometry extraction and CAM tree validation. Build the FeasibilityOrchestratorEngine that chains all layers.

units.title: FeasibilityOrchestratorEngine: master orchestrator chaining all 6 layers
steps: fullAnalysis(): run complete forward simulation with all checks
whatIf(): test impact of moving one operation
Chain: WorkpieceState → Accessibility → Workholding → Rigidity → Sequence → Report
Output: CompleteFeasibilityReport with per-operation risk, dead-ends, suggestions

units.title: PP Pipeline Stage 0.8: feasibility pre-check before physics optimization
steps: Add Stage 0.8 to PostProcessorPipelineEngine between smart defaults (0.6) and physics (1.1)
Quick mode: check top risks, add warnings to pipeline output
Full mode: forward simulation, block pipeline if dead-end detected
exit_conditions: Dead-end blocks pipeline with actionable error
Quick mode adds warnings without blocking

units.title: CNC Simulation bridge: feed IPW state for progressive physics verification
steps: Feed WorkpieceState to CNCSimulationPipelineEngine at each operation boundary
Block-by-block force check against evolving geometry (not just static stock)
Detect mid-program force spikes from changing engagement conditions
Wire to PhysicsAwareSimulationEngine for thermal/deflection/Ra tracking
exit_conditions: Simulation uses evolving IPW, not static stock
Force spikes from geometry changes detected

units.title: CAM + Fusion integration: pre-validate sequences, extract live geometry
steps: CNCProgramAssemblerEngine pre-hook: validate sequence before assembly
Fusion360LiveBridgeEngine: extract B-rep geometry for Level 3 analysis
Fusion CAM tree reader (via LiveBridge): read operation list, tool assignments, setup orientations
AutoResequence: if dead-end found, suggest valid ordering via MCP response
exit_conditions: CAM assembly pre-check catches dead-ends before G-code generation
Fusion geometry extraction works for Level 3 analysis
